name: iOCO Limited
source: iOCO Limited (formerly EOH Holdings Limited) audited annual financial statements for the year ended 31 July 2026, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 15 (PDF page 17), figures in Rand thousand and stored here in ZAR. CRON 2026-10-14 FY2026 column added from the audited statement (Moore Johannesburg Incorporated, unmodified opinion). Ties in the filing: Revenue 5,732,561 less Cost of sales 4,145,903 equals Gross profit 1,586,658 exactly; Profit before taxation 422,541 less Taxation 65,414 equals Profit for the year 357,127 exactly. Source URL https://www.ioco.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/iOCO-AFS-July2026.pdf
reconciliation_note: FY2026 bridges, all from the printed statement: Revenue 5,732,561 less Cost of sales 4,145,903 equals Gross profit 1,586,658. Operating expenses are stored as 1,103,521, which is the printed operating expenses of 1,102,684 plus the printed net financial asset impairment of 837, so that Gross profit less Operating expenses equals the printed Operating profit of 483,137; the filing prints the impairment on its own line between them. Operating profit 483,137 less Net finance costs 60,596 (printed finance costs 67,724 less printed investment income 7,128) equals the printed Profit before taxation of 422,541. Profit before taxation 422,541 less Income tax 65,414 equals Profit for the year 357,127, of which 351,010 is attributable to owners of iOCO Limited and 6,117 to non-controlling interests; the Net Profit row stores the attributable figure, matching this file FY2025 column of 250,834. Earnings per share 57 cents basic, as printed. Note on the older columns: the FY2025 figures in this file come from a secondary feed and differ slightly from the audited statement, which prints operating profit 420,955, net finance costs 89,103 and earnings per share 40 cents basic where the stored FY2025 column reads 424,281, 87,414 and 0.397967.
